headline: Ocean-freight stress is ELEVATED and easing — 34.1/100; Strait of Hormuz is the lead driver, -94% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **34.1/100** (**elevated**), down 5.2 pts week-over-week. 1 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Strait of Hormuz**, running **5.0/day** vs a normal of **78.6/day** (-94%).
**341** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Market context: Brent crude **$76.49/bbl** (-4.93% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$105.0M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$525K** cost-of-delay ($295K–$852K).
